enterHint: Change line colours, order and devices.
banner: You are editing the network: changes alter who can reach whom.
collapsedNote: There are many devices, so each line is a single stop. You can still rename, recolour, reorder and merge lines; to move devices use the list below the map.
keyboardHint: Choose devices with Enter or Space, then use “Move to…”. Dragging is optional.

selection.splitNeedsOne: To cut, choose devices from one line only.
selection.chooseHint: Choose one or more devices to move them or cut them into a new line.

line.empty: No devices: drag one here or use “Move to…”.

lineMenu.title: Line {{name}}
lineMenu.description: Changing a line does not move devices, except merging and deleting.
lineMenu.name: Name
lineMenu.nameRequired: Write a name for the line.
lineMenu.nameInUse: A line with this name already exists. Choose another.
lineMenu.colourHint: The colour only helps you recognise the line on the map.
lineMenu.mergeNone: There is no other line to merge it into.
lineMenu.deleteDefault: The default line cannot be deleted.

merge.title: Merge {{from}} into {{into}}?
merge.description: The devices of {{from}} move to {{into}} and the line {{from}} goes away. This cannot be undone.
merge.droppedNone: No connection between lines is removed.
merge.dropped_one: 1 connection between lines is removed: with {{peers}}.
merge.dropped_other: {{count}} connections between lines are removed: with {{peers}}.

delete.title: Delete the line {{name}}?
delete.description: The line goes away with its connections to other lines. Its devices go back to the default line. This cannot be undone.
delete.devices_one: {{count}} device goes back to the default line.
delete.devices_other: {{count}} devices go back to the default line.

move.pickDescription: Choose the line. Before moving you will see who will reach whom.
move.title: Move to {{line}}
move.description: Moving changes who can reach whom. Check the preview before you confirm.
move.error: Could not work out the preview: {{message}}
move.ignored_one: {{count}} item cannot be moved and is ignored.
move.ignored_other: {{count}} items cannot be moved and are ignored.
move.pairs: In all, {{gains}} pairs of devices start reaching each other and {{losses}} stop.

preview.same: {{name}} will keep reaching the same devices.

split.title: Cut into a new line
split.description: The chosen devices leave {{from}} and form a new line. Check the preview before you confirm.
split.name: Name of the new line
split.notInheritedNone: The new line starts with no connections, and {{from}} had none.
split.notInherited_one: The new line starts with no connections: 1 connection of {{from}} is not inherited, with {{peers}}.
split.notInherited_other: The new line starts with no connections: {{count}} connections of {{from}} are not inherited, with {{peers}}.

create.title: New line
create.description: Give the line a name and a colour. You can move devices onto it right away.
create.name: Name of the line
create.devicesHint: Before they move you will see who will reach whom.

panel.title: Lines and devices
panel.description: Choose devices with the checkboxes, then move them or cut them into a new line. A line's name opens its settings.
